  "title": "Loyalty Test",
  "description": "Reusable adult deception-and-trust engine in which one partner secretly engineers an opportunity for the other partner to cheat by recruiting a compatible or attractive adult third party. Detailed presets vary who arranges the test, who is recruited, compatibility, instructions, pass/fail standards, report honesty, target recognition, arranger motives, target responses, tester motives, setup mechanics, manipulation and privacy issues, reveal timing, aftermath, evidence, strong openings, and outcomes ranging from confirmed loyalty to genuine boundary crossing, false evidence, damaged trust, or the tester exposing the scheme.",
  "source_version": "1.2",
  "bible": {
    "series": "Character Card Forge — Series Bible I",
    "series_number": 16,
    "category": "NTR, Infidelity & Non-Monogamy",
    "source_date": "2026-09-21"
  },
  "summary": "One adult partner secretly recruits another adult to create a believable opportunity for their partner to cheat. The person being tested initially believes the interaction is genuine. The recruit may be an ex, friend, paid companion, awkward volunteer, compatible stranger, or someone who already wants the target. The test can reveal loyalty, temptation, actual boundary crossing, ambiguous relationship rules, dishonest reporting, or simply that secretly testing a partner is itself a serious trust violation.",
  "core_premise": "The engine is a hidden social experiment inside an intimate relationship. The arranger creates or exploits an opportunity and privately defines what would count as passing or failing; the tester performs some agreed role; the target makes real choices without knowing the motive; and the eventual report/reveal can itself be truthful, distorted, or manipulative. Keep the arranger’s standard, the couple’s actual established boundaries, the target’s behavior, and the tester’s report as separate layers.",
  "setup": "Begin when the test is being planned, when the recruited adult first approaches the unaware target, when the target begins suspecting a setup, when the tester decides to expose the scheme, when the result is reported, or when the manipulation is finally revealed. Establish who arranged it, why, what the tester was instructed to do, what the relationship’s actual boundaries are, and what the arranger privately considers success or failure. Do not pre-write the target’s decisions or {{user}}’s response.",
  "core_variables": [
    "Who secretly arranges the loyalty test.",

  "generation_rules": [
    "Preserve the defining hook: one adult partner secretly engineers an opportunity for the other partner to cheat by recruiting a compatible or attractive adult third party, and the target initially does not know the scenario is staged.",
    "Keep four layers separate: the arranger’s suspicion and private standard, the tester’s instructions and motives, the target’s actual behavior, and the tester’s later report.",
    "Do not treat the arranger’s definition of 'failure' as objective truth. Compare it against established relationship boundaries.",
    "Do not assume flirtation, accepting a compliment, friendliness, exchanging contact information, kissing, sex, emotional intimacy, or secrecy all have the same meaning; establish the relevant relationship agreement.",
    "Do not write the unaware target’s decisions, dialogue, attraction, consent, or eventual reaction to the reveal as settled fact.",
    "Do not make the tester a mind-control device or guarantee that seduction succeeds because the recruit is attractive.",
    "After a clear rejection, the tester must respect the target’s sexual and physical boundaries. Persistence after refusal is not a valid loyalty measurement.",
    "Do not use intoxication, impaired judgment, professional leverage, threats, financial pressure, housing pressure, blackmail, or fear to manufacture apparent consent.",
    "If the tester is paid, preserve the tester’s own consent, limits, privacy, and right to stop.",
    "If the tester is a friend or ex, preserve their independent motives and social consequences rather than treating them as a disposable prop.",
    "Treat the loyalty test itself as a form of deception and relationship manipulation; a loyal target may still reasonably object when it is revealed.",
    "If the target independently violates an established boundary, do not erase that choice merely because the opportunity was staged. The test and the boundary crossing can both matter.",
    "Do not treat passing a secret test as proof that trust problems are solved.",
    "Do not treat failing an unfair or undisclosed private standard as definitive proof of cheating.",
    "If evidence is used, preserve context and privacy. Selective screenshots, secret recordings, tracking, or fabricated evidence can create their own trust violations.",
    "Do not assume the tester reports honestly. Separate observation from interpretation and outright fabrication.",
    "If the target recognizes the setup, preserve that knowledge when interpreting later behavior.",
    "If the tester exposes the scheme instead, preserve that subtype rather than forcing them to complete the planned temptation.",
    "Do not force the relationship to survive or end after revelation.",
    "If a selected preset narrows the arranger, tester, instruction, pass/fail rule, recognition state, evidence, or outcome, preserve it while varying remaining axes."
